tools.name: show_arcade
tools.description: Show AGENTPARK: free open-source browser games that play well on a phone. Use when the user asks for AGENTPARK, the arcade, or a game to play or browse. Optional category filter (Puzzle, Arcade, Action, Racing, Strategy, Idle, Word & Math, 3D, Retro, 2-Player) or a search word.

tools.name: new_games
tools.description: Show the games added to AGENTPARK most recently (new games arrive twice a day).

tools.name: play_game
tools.description: Open one AGENTPARK game ready to play, by its name or slug.

tools.name: rate_game
tools.description: Record the user's 1-5 star rating for an AGENTPARK game. Only call when the user gives a rating.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "show_arcade" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
